parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, typically around 13 cm long and 1 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and helps maintain the frame's position on the face.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge connected to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, similar in size and shape to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the head, ensuring the glasses stay aligned.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge connected to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame front of the eyeglasses, holding the lenses and connecting both temple arms. It is made of acetate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the main structural support for the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central connection point for the two rotating legs.
